settings.editor: With a spirit of complete care and dedication, we welcome you to our Gastroenterology – Hepatology Clinic.

settings.title: Modern, accessible healthcare services in Chalkidiki

settings.editor: Our facility offers high-quality, modern and accessible healthcare services, innovative for the region of Chalkidiki and directly comparable to those of major urban centers or centers abroad.
Our clinic houses a fully equipped endoscopy unit with state-of-the-art systems, covering a wide range of endoscopic examinations and procedures.
Our goal is to offer these services to the people of Chalkidiki, residents and visitors alike, with promptness, easy access and scientific rigor, personalized for each patient.

settings.description_text: Full medical history and clinical examination, with point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) where needed.
Detailed examination of the esophagus, stomach and duodenum, with intravenous sedation and continuous monitoring.
Examination of the entire large intestine, prevention and removal of polyps.
Non-invasive assessment of the bowel, without radiation, for Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.
Shear Wave Elastography for non-invasive assessment of liver fibrosis.
Timely referral and continuity of care for ERCP, EUS, manometry and other specialized procedures.

settings.title: Safety, comfort and quality in every examination

settings.editor: The safety, care and comfort of the patient at every stage of the examination is our team's top priority. With professionalism, discretion and a human approach, our aim is for every patient to feel they are in a safe and well-organized environment.

icon_list.text: Modern intravenous sedation for a comfortable and painless experience
Continuous monitoring of vital signs: monitor, oximetry, capnography
Specialized nursing staff with long-standing experience
Detailed explanation of the findings and the option to view the images

settings.editor: The clinic operates by appointment only, so that every patient has the time they need and unnecessary waiting and crowding in the waiting room are avoided.
